text_block_list.text:
One day, Tokai Teio and Mejiro McQueen 
were summoned to the Student Council room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pardon us.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez, what's this important talk about?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for calling you here so 
suddenly. There is something I would like 
to ask of you two.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What is it, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like the two of you to serve as 
models for a promotional poster created by 
the URA.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa, poster models?! Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is... an honor. I would be delighted 
to accept, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why is McQueen doing it with me, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because I personally recommended the two 
of you... Do you have any objections?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's Prez's recommendation... I 
guess it's totally fine, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I, too, am curious about the reason for 
our selection. Why Teio-san and myself...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The reason, you ask. I could simply 
tell you, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is an excellent opportunity. I would 
like you two to contemplate something.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want each of you to consider why the 
other was chosen as a poster model. Think 
over the reasons and report back to me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh~~! I have to think about why McQueen 
was chosen instead of thinking about 
myself~~?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do not overcomplicate it. Consider it a 
simple assignment from me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh~, that's not simple at all~~... 
Figuring out why McQueen was chosen, of 
all things~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, it's 'cause McQueen 
wouldn't drop it that we got saddled with 
this tough assignment!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I merely inquired about the reason. 
Rather, what of yourself, accepting the 
President's words without giving them a 
second thought!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wasn't thinking at all... 
Mmh, but now that we've accepted, guess we 
got no choice...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know! If we have to do it anyway, let's 
make a match out of it, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A match...? But how would we determine a 
winner desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We bring our answers to the President, and 
whoever hits the nail right on the head 
wins! How about that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... Very well then. However, if we 
are doing this, I will be taking it 
entirely seriously, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just what I wanted! All right, here we 
go... Ready, START!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa?! Why are you heading in the 
same direction! Don't get in my way~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am simply going to ask everyone in the 
classroom...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! I thought of doing that first! Don't 
copy me~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am not copying you desu wa! Would you 
please stop making such absurd false 
accusations, Teio-san?

And so, shoving and jostling each other, 
the two dashed down the hallway.
